navigation.notes: BLOCKED BY ROBOTS. Verified 2026-08-30. The bepress/Digital Commons host lawdigitalcommons.bc.edu has been decommissioned: every path (including /robots.txt and /{series}/) returns HTTP 302 to https://lira.bc.edu/ (root, not a deep link), so no Digital Commons surface -- no all_issues.html, no /cgi/viewcontent.cgi, no /do/oai/ -- remains reachable. The successor repository lira.bc.edu is a Next.js app whose /robots.txt allowlists 24 named commercial/search/AI crawler UAs and ends with 'User-agent: *  Disallow: /'. Our collector is not one of the named agents, so all of lira.bc.edu is Disallowed for us; /api/* and /auth are additionally Disallowed for everyone. No Crawl-delay is declared anywhere. Per the repo's respectful-acquisition policy no enumeration, sitemap fetch, or PDF retrieval was attempted. Unblocking requires out-of-band permission from BC Libraries (or a bulk export), not a technical workaround.
